subtests.name: Scripts in this window should be self-attributed
Scripts in subframes should be descendant-attributed
A long busy wait in a requestAnimationFrame should not be observable by same-origin iframes
Scripts from an ancestor window should be ancestor-attributed
Scripts from a sibling iframe should be same-page-attributed
Scripts from a detached iframe should have other attribution and null window
Scripts in a same-origin grandchild nested inside a cross-origin iframe are attributed to the top-level same-origin root
